temperature.source: a development board on a bench, 0 to 40 C round it

tolerance.source: 1 % thick-film resistors on the board. The RP2350's pull-up (32k), the buffer's resistance (112.5 Ohm), VREF, VUVLO and the FB pin's currents are already their datasheets' worst values; the corners move the resistors 1 % too, past the worst. C30, C31 (10 uF) and C42 (22 uF) X5R: 10 % and their loss at 5 V of DC bias, taken as 50 %. LCABLE: a USB-C cable 0.5 to 1.5 m long
